lines: A warehouse, not far from the airport where the major commotion was unfolding.
There, sitting cross-legged with his eyes closed, was a man in the attire of a Buddhist priest, looking as though he had escaped from a period drama.

He was a dissolute warrior monk purporting to be the reincarnation of an oni, who, despite being pure flesh and blood, and not having undergone one bit of physical modification, boasted power and speed greater than a
He held the nickname of the “Cyborg Hunter”, his deepest desire being to destroy a thousand famous cyborgs.
In accordance with that nickname, he was wearing the heads of defeated cyborgs around his neck as a string of rosary beads.
At that point, a man in a black suit burst in.
Benkei's eyelids, which had been as unmoving as a statue, twitched open.
「This is why I told you not to rely on cyborgs, did I not?」
「One of the enemies is a cyborg. Another one looks to be a demon, probably.」
「What?! The enemy have a cyborg?! Why did you not tell me that sooner?!」
He slowly rose to his feet.
The black-suited man instinctively backed away, due to the illusion that his enormous body had grown yet another size larger.
「I thought that recovering stolen data was going to be a boring job, but it would appear I will be able to have a little fun with it.」
Benkei took a metal club that had been placed on the floor into his hand.
「Fetch data on the enemy for Benkei-dono!」
A cyborg agent, who had been monitoring the battle at the airport from a distance, displayed the combat footage he had brought back.
「I dunno about this strange demon woman, but I recognize the face of this one. This is undoubtedly Koukawa Asuka.」
「Fufufu, this has gotten interesting, for one of the DSO's cyborgs to come butting in uninvited.」
Benkei swung his enormous metal club around once or twice, as though he were holding a twig.
And then, he glanced at the face of the cyborg who had brought back this intel.
「By the way, you there. You were brave to come back here.」
「All on your own, without even fighting. Truly laughable.」
The moment that the surviving cyborg reflexively backed away due to his vicious smile, the smile of an oni itself,
The metal club had been swung downward with speed too quick for the eye, and pulverized the man.
「I did tell you I'm not fond of cyborgs, didn't I? You're lucky you're human.」
「Be not so concerned. I'll do the job. Now, where is the Steel Reaper?」
「W-We're having a detached force pursue her......」
Benkei slowly answered, and then amusedly stroked the rosary of cyborg heads which hung from his neck.
「What the hell is going on here?!!」
Scowling at Asuka and Lena was a stern-looking girl who wore a Japanese sword on her hip,
Accompanied behind her by a group who looked, to all all appearances, to be Taimanin.
（Somehow, I have a feeling there's been a misunderstanding. Or maybe I should say, that things are about to get bad.）
「You're the ones who caused this devastation, aren't you?」
This girl had looked over the airport, which was still in flames, and arbitrarily decided that it was their doing.
（Awww～～, I knew you would think that. Well, I won't say we bear no responsibility, though......）
「Who's this, showing up all of a sudden?!」
Before Asuka could say anything, Lena was talking back again.
「I'm a Taimanin, Kuroda Tomoe. Those horns on your head... Are you a demon?!」
「Wha? Taimanin, you say? I see. Then, I'll introduce myself too. I am Lena, Hell Knight of Nomad!」
A needlessly brazen declaration that she was a Hell Knight.
Tomoe opened her eyes wide, and her subordinate Taimanin also became astir.
「Wait, wait!! Sure, this girl seems to be a Hell Knight from Nomad, but...」
「Not “seems”. I'm unmistakably a Hell Knight of Nomad!」
「We're not the ones who made this place such a mess. Some weird cyborgs suddenly attacked us!」
「Cyborgs? The guys who are lying over there, you mean.」
With her hand still on her sword, Tomoe glanced at the cyborgs' remains.
「You look like you're human. Surely you're not siding with Nomad?」
「N-No! I'm, uh...... a wind user, just passing by. I just happened to meet this girl here, today.」
Unable to say that she was Koukawa Asuka of the DSO, she told her the same thing that she had just told Lena.
「Exactly! She's a wind user, just passing by. I don't even know her name!」
Lena vouched for her, but conversely, it sounded like a lie.
「Passing by......? Then why were you guys attacked by cyborgs?」
「But probably, it's because I received this by mistake. It looks like these guys came to retrieve it.」
Without thinking, Asuka produced the memory card from earlier for Tomoe, who looked like she was about to slash at them any time now.
「You had that?! Why didn't you say earlier?! Were you trying to swindle me?!」
The brunt of accusation shifted towards Asuka.
「Wait, that's not it. I got mistaken for you!」
「Mistaken? What do you mean?! That's mine! Give it back!」
Lena held her hand out firmly.
Even Asuka unintentionally raised her voice due to that accusatory way of speaking.
「I got attacked by those guys because of this! It's not like I can just hand it over with an “Okay, here you go,” is it?! What the hell kind of data is this?!」
「Huh? What do you mean, you can't tell me?」
「The contents don't really matter, do they? It's mine, so give it back!」
「I'm telling you to explain this properly!」
It was tit for tat. The two of them glared at each other, paying no attention to Tomoe.
「Whatever. The particulars aside, it looks like there's no doubt that you guys have something to do with the state of this place.」
「As a Taimanin, I shall arrest you!」
